title: Quick enchant
description: Quickly enchant your items without breaking your fingers
body:
Just want to Enchant you gear quickly? Use /quickenchant to do exactly that

# Warning!
This project is about to get a complete rework, so the usage, as well as the methode will be different than before.
So do not get used to using this just yet. (The general function will stay exactly the same)

# Usage (Subject to change)
type /fastenchant or /quickenchant <item> <delay> <incompatible mode>
(thats it)

# Installation
1. Install fabric X or later
2. Install 1.21+ (Currently only 1.21-6 is supported, but that will change in a bit)
3. Install the fabric API
4. Begin playing

# Compatibility
Currently it only supports some vanilla items, and the vanilla enchanting way + essentialsx enchanting way, tho the solution it made unoptimized

# For the future
I am slowly working on a full remake of the mod that will support every item, even modded ones, have a config GUI, custom profiles, and some other minor stuff.
But thats currently not released, nor done

# Note:
This can NOT enchant your items in survival, and is only usable when you have the appropiate server permissions, and therefor is not an unfair advantage
